corrections.why: Both register pages say the tower was removed around 2010, so it no longer stands

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's standing status matches a register that lists lookouts as they stood when registered; both register pages say the tower was removed around 2010.

The register's Built field gives 1952, and its description says the tower was relocated and reconstructed on this site that year. 1952 is the year it went up at DeSoto Falls; the original build date and earlier site are not given.

sources.title: A History of State Forestry in Alabama

notes_for_editor: Only the two register pages describe this tower, and they repeat one description, so the history is thin. Both give 1952 for the reconstruction and removal around 2010. The original construction date and earlier site are unknown. The 100 ft figure is the register's tower height, not confirmed as height to the cab floor, so height_m is omitted. The NHLR page gives the state number as AL 36, but the FFLOS cross-reference says AL 37; the record keeps AL 36, the NHLR page's own number. Access is set to closed because no tower remains; the park itself is public. The state forestry PDF is a manuscript submitted in March 1961, reproduced by the Department of Conservation; its author is not named in the text read, and its 157-tower count is general, not specific to this site. No new photos. Two web searches added nothing specific to this tower.
